text: Doctor is so kind, clinic is very clean and nice staff

Came for scaling and filling. Very reasonable price. I was handled by 2 different dentists on 2 separate visits, both are very professional and gentle. No hard sell or ads. If you’re the type that hates going for dental fix like me, this is probably the best place you want to get treated.

The doctor and staff weren't very pleasant. The doctor forgot to sign my social security form, so I had to wait almost 20 minutes while the doctor served other patients. The staff didn't follow up or say anything. Even for a simple scaling procedure, the instruments touched many areas that weren't my teeth. The doctor spoke curtly and didn't ask if I was okay or in pain. When told to close my mouth, the doctor just said "shut your mouth," which was quite shocking. Maybe I'm being too picky, but other clinics aren't like this. This will be my only visit.
Yesterday I had my wisdom tooth extracted by Dr. Gif. It didn't hurt at all during the procedure. Even after I got home, it didn't hurt much. The doctor did a great job.

I've been getting my dental work done here for many years, including wisdom tooth extractions, teeth cleaning, and fillings. It's my regular clinic. I recently recommended my parents to get their dental work here as well. There's convenient parking right in front of the clinic, and it's clean.

The staff were polite and provided excellent service. The clinic was clean and beautifully decorated. The doctor did a great job. This was my first time getting my teeth cleaned, and the doctor was very helpful and spoke to me kindly.

It was a terrible experience. I ended up with three sores in my mouth from the sharp metal tool they used to check my teeth and from the scaler cutting my cheek and lip.
The dentist's instruments moved very quickly, perhaps due to experience, but personally, I felt they weren't very thorough. The instruments kept cutting into my mouth and cheek. The dental work itself only hurt for a short time, but the sores in my mouth take a long time to heal, making eating difficult.

I also wish the dentist had explained things more during the check-up. I understand the dentist recognized the problems and what needed to be done, but I'd like them to be more detailed. For example, during the check-up, when they mentioned I had two cavities that needed fillings, I'd like them to specify the location, the severity of the cavities, and what habits might have caused them.

As for the price, fillings here cost 800 baht regardless of the severity of the cavity. I don't really like that price. I've been to other places where minor cavities only cost 400-600 baht, and major ones 800 baht.

The staff were lovely and provided good service. However, the dentist spoke strangely, seemingly trying to push extra charges. Her words were very unpleasant. I've been to many dental clinics, but this is the first time I've encountered a dentist who spoke to customers like that. I probably won't dare go back there again.
I come here every time to get my teeth cleaned. I also get my teeth straightened here with Dr. Pang. She's very good. The clinic looks minimal. I didn't have to wait long to see the doctor.
I came in for a consultation, and the medical team provided excellent service.
Good service, clean clinic, lovely doctor, lovely staff ☺️
Convenient location, kind doctor, good service from staff.

Having my wisdom tooth extracted by Dr. Thir wasn't as painful as I expected. In fact, it was much more painful than I anticipated 😂 But the doctor managed to get it out. What a relief! The doctor and staff took great care of me. …

I went to get my wisdom teeth extracted. At first, I was terrified of the pain, so I only asked the dentist to extract one. But in reality, the dentist was very gentle; the anesthetic injection was mild, and my fear was gone. After extracting one tooth, I told the dentist I wanted to have another one done right away. It was so easy! I was very impressed.

text: The clinic is clean, the reception staff are friendly, the doctor is kind, and has a gentle touch. He gives good advice both before and after treatment. I'm very impressed. ❤️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️😊 …
Getting dental implants here is quite good. I can eat normally. The doctor is very skilled and gives good advice. The staff are friendly and very impressed.

The reception staff were friendly and polite, and they followed up and confirmed the appointment beforehand.
The equipment is modern, the doctor provides excellent service, the clinic is clean and safe, and it's conveniently located.

This was my first time at this dental clinic. They explained everything in detail, which was great. Upon arrival, the dentist and assistants were very helpful, polite, and friendly. The clinic atmosphere was relaxing and clean.

The procedure itself was okay, but the payment process was terrible. When I booked an appointment for a teeth cleaning, the staff quoted a final price of 999 baht, without mentioning any additional charges. On the day of the procedure, as I was about to lie down, the dentist said there was an extra 300 baht for root canal scaling. I didn't want to think too much about it and just went along with it. When I went to pay, there was another 90 baht charge I didn't understand. When I asked what it was for, the staff stammered and said it was for mouthwash and equipment. I've been to many clinics before and never been charged extra for these things, and none of them have ever exceeded the social security insurance price. What is this? Charging for mouthwash? I told them that no other clinic has ever charged for mouthwash or these kinds of miscellaneous items. If they had informed me of all the details on the day of the appointment, I wouldn't have minded. Trying to sneak in a charge at the last minute is outrageous.

Excellent service. The dentist did a very thorough cleaning (tartar removal), gave a detailed check-up and good advice. Importantly, they were gentle and kind. I'm usually very afraid of dental procedures. The price was also affordable.
